metadata.name: instance

variables.name: description
variables.example: Application server for the billing API

metadata.description: A single hardened Compute Engine VM: private by default, OS Login, Shielded VM, dedicated service account and optional CMEK boot disk.

variables.name: project_id
variables.description: ID of the GCP project the VM is created in. 6-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

validations.error_message: project_id must be 6-30 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, start with a letter and not end with a hyphen.

variables.name: name
variables.description: Name of the VM, unique within the project and zone. 1-63 characters: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (RFC 1035).

validations.error_message: name must be RFC 1035 compliant: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen.

variables.name: zone
variables.description: Zone the VM runs in, for example us-central1-a. It must be in the same region as the subnetwork.

validations.error_message: zone must be a zone such as "us-central1-a" in the subnetwork's region.

variables.name: machine_type
variables.description: Machine type that sets the VM's vCPUs and memory, for example e2-standard-2, n2d-standard-4 or custom-4-8192 (custom-<vCPUs>-<memory MB>).

validations.error_message: machine_type must be a machine type such as "e2-standard-2" or "custom-4-8192".

variables.name: description
variables.description: Free-text description of the VM, shown in the Cloud Console. Leave empty for none.

variables.name: labels
variables.description: Labels applied to the VM and its boot disk, as key = value pairs. Keys: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter (max 63). Values: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - (max 63).

validations.error_message: Label keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$ and values must match ^[a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.

variables.name: subnetwork
variables.description: Subnet the VM's network interface is attached to, as an ID (projects/<project>/regions/<region>/subnetworks/<name>) or full self link. A Shared VPC subnet in a host project works too.

validations.error_message:
subnetwork must be a subnet ID (projects/

/regions//subnetworks/) or self link.

variables.name: network_ip
variables.description: Static internal IPv4 address for the VM, for example 10.10.0.5. It must be a free address inside the subnet's range. Leave empty for an ephemeral address.

validations.error_message: network_ip must be a single IPv4 address such as "10.10.0.5".

variables.name: network_tags
variables.description: Network tags used by firewall rules and routes to target this VM, for example ["web", "allow-health-checks"]. Each tag: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.

validations.error_message: network_tags must be RFC 1035 compliant: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter.
network_tags must not contain duplicates.

variables.name: enable_public_access
variables.description: Attach an ephemeral external (public) IPv4 address to the VM. Off by default: VMs are private and should reach the internet through Cloud NAT.

variables.name: hostname
variables.description: Custom fully qualified hostname for the VM, for example app01.internal.example.com. Leave empty to use the GCP default (<name>.<zone>.c.<project>.internal).

validations.error_message: hostname must be a fully qualified DNS name such as "app01.internal.example.com".

variables.name: enable_ip_forwarding
variables.description: Allow the VM to send and receive packets for IP addresses other than its own (needed for NAT gateways, routers and network appliances). Off by default.

variables.name: boot_disk_image
variables.description:
Image the boot disk is created from: / such as debian-cloud/debian-12, projects/

/global/images/family/, or a full image self link.

validations.error_message:
boot_disk_image must be an image reference such as "debian-cloud/debian-12", projects/

/global/images/family/ or an image self link.

variables.name: boot_disk_type
variables.description: Boot disk type. One of: pd-balanced (default), pd-standard, pd-ssd, pd-extreme, hyperdisk-balanced, hyperdisk-throughput, hyperdisk-extreme.

validations.error_message: boot_disk_type must be one of pd-standard, pd-balanced, pd-ssd, pd-extreme, hyperdisk-balanced, hyperdisk-throughput or hyperdisk-extreme.

variables.name: boot_disk_size_gb
variables.description: Boot disk size in GB, a whole number of at least 10. Leave empty to use the image's own size.

validations.error_message: boot_disk_size_gb must be a whole number of at least 10.

variables.name: boot_disk_kms_key_self_link
variables.description:
Cloud KMS key that encrypts the boot disk (CMEK), as projects/

/locations//keyRings//cryptoKeys/. Leave empty for Google-managed encryption. The Compute Engine service agent needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the key.

validations.error_message:
boot_disk_kms_key_self_link must be a crypto key ID: projects/

/locations//keyRings//cryptoKeys/.

variables.name: service_account_email
variables.description: Email of the dedicated service account the VM runs as, <name>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com. The Compute Engine default service account is rejected. The scope is always cloud-platform, so access is controlled by IAM roles only.

validations.error_message: service_account_email must be a dedicated service account (<sa>@<project>.iam.gserviceaccount.com); the Compute Engine default service account is not allowed.

variables.name: deletion_protection
variables.description: Prevent the VM from being deleted (by Terraform or in the Console) until this is turned off. On by default.

variables.name: enable_secure_boot
variables.description: Shielded VM Secure Boot: only boot software signed by trusted keys. On by default; turn off only for images with unsigned drivers or kernels.

variables.name: enable_vtpm
variables.description: Shielded VM virtual Trusted Platform Module (vTPM), used for measured boot and integrity monitoring. On by default.

variables.name: enable_integrity_monitoring
variables.description: Shielded VM integrity monitoring: compare each boot against a known-good baseline and report deviations. On by default.

variables.name: enable_confidential_compute
variables.description: Run the VM as a Confidential VM with encrypted memory. Needs a supported machine family (for example n2d, c2d or c3) and disables live migration. Off by default.

variables.name: provisioning_model
variables.description: STANDARD (default) for a regular VM, or SPOT for a much cheaper VM that Google can stop or delete at any time to reclaim capacity.

validations.error_message: provisioning_model must be STANDARD or SPOT.

variables.name: spot_termination_action
variables.description: What happens to a SPOT VM when Google reclaims it: STOP (default, the VM and its disks are kept) or DELETE. Ignored for STANDARD VMs.

validations.error_message: spot_termination_action must be STOP or DELETE.

variables.name: startup_script
variables.description: Script run as root on every boot (stored as the startup-script metadata value), for example a bash script starting with #!/bin/bash. Leave empty for none. Do not put secrets here; read them from Secret Manager instead.

variables.name: metadata
variables.description: Extra instance metadata as key = value pairs. The keys enable-oslogin, block-project-ssh-keys, serial-port-enable, ssh-keys and sshKeys are reserved (the module enforces OS Login and blocks SSH keys and the serial console); use startup_script instead of a startup-script key.

validations.error_message: metadata must not set enable-oslogin, block-project-ssh-keys, serial-port-enable, ssh-keys or sshKeys; the module enforces OS Login and blocks SSH keys and the serial port.
Set the startup script either through startup_script or through a metadata startup-script key, not both.

variables.name: attached_disks
variables.description: Existing persistent disks to attach to the VM, as a list of objects with source (disk ID or self link), device_name (RFC 1035) and optional mode (READ_WRITE by default, or READ_ONLY). Leave empty for none.

validations.condition_raw: length(distinct([for d in var.attached_disks : d.device_name])) == length(var.attached_disks)
validations.error_message: attached_disks device_name values must be unique.
attached_disks need a disk ID or self link as source, an RFC 1035 device_name and mode READ_WRITE or READ_ONLY (or null).
